mapper.select: SELECT no,title,name as instructor,star,student_count,content,thumbnail FROM course c JOIN member m ON c.instructor_no=m.member_id WHERE no=#{course_no}
SELECT no,name,rating,review,like_count,TO_CHAR(e.regdate,'yyyy-mm-dd') as dbday FROM course_evaluation e JOIN member m ON e.member_id=m.member_id WHERE course_no=#{course_no} ORDER BY e.regdate DESC
